meta.name: experimental-design
meta.description: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening many factors, response-surface optimization, crossover or repeated-measures or split-plot designs, cluster/group randomization, Latin squares, plate layouts, batch/run-order effects, replication vs. pseudoreplication, or sequential/adaptive/group-sequential designs. Trigger even for informal phrasings like "how should I set up this experiment", "how do I avoid confounding", "what's the best way to test these 6 factors", or "assign these mice to conditions". For computing the sample size or power once the design is chosen, use statistical-power; for analyzing data already collected, use statistical-analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计实验方案，确保结果可解释
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划实验，需要选择合适的设计方法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if planning a study and need to choose a proper design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在数据收集前帮你设计实验：根据你的问题和实验单元选择合适的实验设计，生成随机化分组表和实验运行顺序，并提醒避开伪重复、混杂等结构错误。
howto.when: 当你在计划一项研究、问如何把对象分到各组，或提到随机化、区组、析因设计等关键词时触发；口语化的“怎么设这个实验”“怎么避免混杂”也会触发。

say.text: 我有60只小鼠，分治疗和对照两组，帮我做区组随机化分组。
say.note: 生成带种子的分组表，可保存为CSV。

say.text: 7个因子要做筛选，给我一个 Plackett-Burman 设计。
say.note: 返回按随机顺序排列的筛选矩阵。

say.text: 两个因子要优化响应值，生成中心复合设计。
say.note: 给出含弯曲项的运行顺序表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design experiments before data collection: choose a design, generate randomized allocation tables and DOE run matrices, and flag structural pitfalls (pseudoreplication, confounding).
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning a study, asking how to assign subjects/groups, mentioning terms such as randomization, blocking, factorial designs, etc.; also informal questions like "how do I avoid confounding".

say_en.text: I have 60 mice to assign to treatment and control. Generate a blocked randomization schedule.
Screen 7 factors — generate a Plackett-Burman design.
Optimize a response over two factors — give me a central composite design.
